doctrine.history: Resolution records are append-only editorial decisions. Generated queue refreshes must not delete or rewrite them.
doctrine.recurrence: A resolved story stays out of the active queue unless materially new evidence appears. Stale and out-of-scope decisions are terminal for the matched story.
doctrine.canonicalBoundary: A resolution can direct work toward a canonical owner, but only the canonical domain may publish the resulting civic fact or status.
doctrine.matchRule: Preserve the original candidate id, story-cluster id and known source URLs so later refreshes can recognize the same story even when the lead publisher changes.
